description: Remove the North Star Coffee Lounge waitress/knife sequence. Bounds snapped to detected shot transitions (threshold 0.30) nearest the owner times 1:41:44–1:47:02. Out-point is the cut from Duke's knife close-up onto the diner neon; in-point is the cut from the sobbing waitress onto the Red Shark driving scene. Hard picture cut on those frames; 0.5 s audio fade-out/fade-in at the join (no overlapping acrossfade, so A/V stay in sync).
